description: Send a draft. It leaves the mailbox and consumes the draft. Only a draft is sent: a message already sent or received is refused, and nothing leaves. Call this only when the person asked for this message to go; when they asked to prepare one, draft it instead. A request id already spent sends nothing again: the answer says whether that send went or may have gone.

id.description: The id a draft tool answered, or the draftId a search or a read answered.

mailbox.description: The mailbox's name or its email address.

requestId.description: Your own id for this send, new for every message. One whose send went or may have gone sends nothing again.

name: drafts_send
title: Send a draft
